name: Shackleton rim
note: Most illuminated rim point (S) in Gläser et al. 2018.
sourceLabel: Gläser et al. 2018, Planet. Space Sci. (NASA NTRS)

name: Connecting Ridge
note: Site C1 on the ridge between Shackleton and de Gerlache; Artemis III candidate region.
sourceLabel: Gläser et al. 2018, Planet. Space Sci. (NASA NTRS)

name: de Gerlache rim
note: Point C of Bussey et al. 2010; Artemis III candidate region.
sourceLabel: Bryant 2009, JPL IPN Progress Report 42-176; Bussey et al. 2010

name: Nobile rim
note: Approximate point on the NE rim of Nobile crater (Artemis III region 'Nobile Rim 1'); region-level precision.
sourceLabel: IAU Gazetteer (Nobile) + NASA Artemis III regions 2022

name: Malapert massif
note: Point M1 near the Malapert summit.

name: Leibnitz beta plateau
note: Plateau point from Kaguya-based illumination study; now part of 'Mons Mouton Plateau'.

name: Haworth
note: Approximate point on the high ground at the north-east rim of Haworth crater (Artemis III region); region-level precision.
sourceLabel: NASA SVS: Artemis III Landing Region Candidates

name: Mons Mouton
note: Centre of the LROC Mons Mouton Plateau region of interest (former VIPER target, IM-2 area).

name: Chandrayaan-3 Vikram
note: Landed 2023-08-23 ('Statio Shiv Shakti'). Outside the polar DEM: flat horizon.

name: Apollo 11
note: Tranquility Base, landed 1969-07-20 20:17 UTC. Flat horizon (equatorial contrast case).

name: Apollo 17
note: Taurus-Littrow, landed 1972-12-11. Flat horizon (no polar DEM).
